title: Perforated lantern (OpenSCAD)
description: OpenSCAD performs exact CSG differences on cylinders. The scene parses the exported ASCII STL; edit lantern.scad and rerun the recipe to change the model.
description_ko: OpenSCAD가 원기둥을 빼는 CSG 연산으로 형태를 만들어요. 씬은 실제 ASCII STL을 읽어요. lantern.scad를 수정하고 레시피를 다시 실행하면 모델이 바뀌어요.
prompt: A scripted solid lantern with staggered circular windows, exported as a real STL.
made_with: openscad through a bundled, executed recipe
